name: Acid Squelch
description: VCO 1's saw at 16' through a low-pass peaking near its singing that the envelope snaps open: a squelching bass.

name: Band Bass
description: The saw at 16' between the high-pass and the low-pass, both peaking toward each other, the envelope sweeping the low-pass: a vocal, talking bass.

name: Fat Bass
description: VCO 1's saw at 16' and VCO 2's square at 16' through a low-pass the envelope opens at each note: a thick, punchy bass.

name: Fifth Bass
description: VCO 2 a fifth over VCO 1, both saws at 16', the low-pass half open: a bass that plays power chords.

name: Filter FM Growl
description: VCO 1's saw at 16' through a peaking low-pass whose cutoff VCO 2 moves at audio rate, a little off the key: a growling, metallic bass.

name: Following Bass
description: The keyboard's voltage patched to the low-pass, so it opens up the keys as a bass's tone does, and EG 1 into the low-pass in EG 2's place for its envelope: a bass that stays even across the keys.

name: Growl Bass
description: Two saws whose low-pass the MG's triangle moves fast, a few times a beat, peaking: a growling bass.

name: Hard Sync Bass
description: VCO 2's narrow pulse patched into the high-pass's cutoff at audio rate, tearing at the saw's low end: a harsh, buzzing bass.

name: Noise Edge Bass
description: Two saws whose low-pass takes white noise in EG 2's place, a gritty edge on a low body: a rough, distorted bass.

name: Pitch Drop Bass
description: EG 1 starts the oscillators a little under the key and lets them rise into it at once: a bass with a punch of pitch at each note.

name: Pluck Bass
description: The saw at 16' through a peaking low-pass, the envelope snapping it open and falling to a little: a short, plucked bass.

name: Pulse Bass
description: VCO 1's narrow pulse at 16' and VCO 2's square at 16', the low-pass half open: a nasal, hollow bass.

name: Ring Bass
description: The ring modulator under VCO 1's saw, VCO 2 a little off an octave, through a low-pass: a bass with a metallic clang in it.

name: Round Bass
description: Two saws at 16' a few cents apart, the low-pass lightly peaking and opened a little at each note: a warm, round bass.

name: Rubber Bass
description: The saw and the square at 16' through a peaking low-pass that the envelope bounces up at each note and back: a bouncy, rubbery bass.

name: Soft Triangle Bass
description: VCO 1's triangle at 16' with a little of VCO 2's saw, the low-pass dark: a soft bass for quiet songs.

name: Square Sub
description: VCO 2's square an octave under VCO 1's triangle, the low-pass low: a deep, steady sub.

name: Squelch Glide
description: The saw at 16' through a low-pass near singing, gliding where the notes touch, the envelope flicking the peak at each: an acid line.

name: Thin Bass
description: Two saws with the high-pass taking the low end away and peaking at its corner: a thin, honking bass that leaves room for a kick.

name: Velvet Bass
description: Two saws and the square together, the low-pass low and smooth, a slow release: a dark, velvet bass.

name: Wobble Bass
description: The MG's triangle sweeping the peaking low-pass slowly through its full travel: a wobbling bass.

name: Brass
description: Two saws a few cents apart through a low-pass the envelope opens slowly and lets fall a little: a warm brass.

name: Bright Brass
description: Two saws a few cents apart through a low-pass the envelope swells open, overshoots a little and settles bright: a solo horn with bite.

name: Fall Brass
description: Horn-like saws that EG 2 starts a little sharp and lets fall into each note as the filter swells: a brass lead with a lip on each note.

name: Soft Brass
description: Two saws whose low-pass swells open slowly and not far: a mellow horn for held lines.

name: Alarm
description: The MG's square into the pitch, a fourth up and back, a bright pulse: an alarm.

name: Falling Bomb
description: A square thrown high by EG 2 and falling slowly as it decays, noise under it: a bomb falling.

name: Laser Zap
description: EG 1 takes both oscillators far under the key and lets them rise to it at each note, through a resonant low-pass: a laser's zap.

name: Noise Wind
description: VCO 1's white noise through a low-pass peaking hard, which the MG sweeps slowly up and down: wind.

name: Robot Voice
description: The ring modulator between the filters peaking, the MG's square jumping the band: a machine that talks in two syllables.

name: Sample Bleeps
description: White noise into the sample and hold, clocked by the MG's square, and the held voltage into the total: the pitch and the peaking low-pass jump to a new random place at every step while a key is held.

name: Siren
description: The MG as a rising saw sweeps the pulse's pitch far up and drops it again, over and over: a siren.

name: Surf
description: White noise through the low-pass that the MG's rising saw opens slowly and drops: waves breaking.

name: Talking Ring
description: The ring modulator, VCO 2 played by EG 1's voltage in hertz, through the two filters peaking toward each other, which EG 1 and its reverse draw apart as it rises: each note says "yaow".

name: Whistle
description: No oscillator: the low-pass singing by itself at its peak's top, the MG lending it a vibrato. It sings at the same pitch whatever the key; move the low-pass's cutoff to play it.

name: Clav Pulse
description: VCO 1's narrow pulse through a peaking low-pass that snaps shut: a clav's funky bite.

name: Ring Bell
description: The ring modulator alone, VCO 2 a fifth over VCO 1's square at 4', on a long decay: a clangorous, metallic bell.

name: Ring Chime
description: The ring modulator with VCO 2 two octaves up and a little off, a quick strike that rings: a bright chime.

name: Square Organ
description: VCO 1's pulse at its square and VCO 2's square an octave up, the envelope square on and off: a thin, steady organ.

name: Fifth Lead
description: VCO 2 a fifth over VCO 1, both saws, the low-pass open: a lead in parallel fifths.

name: Following Lead
description: Two saws a few cents apart with the keyboard's voltage patched to the low-pass, so its corner rides over every note as a lead's should, peaking: a bright lead even across the keys.

name: Gliding Lead
description: The triangle and VCO 2's square an octave up through an open low-pass, gliding from note to note with a little vibrato: a soft, singing lead.

name: Growl Lead
description: VCO 2 a little under VCO 1, patched into the low-pass's cutoff at audio rate: a snarling, growling lead.

name: Hollow Band Lead
description: Two saws between the filters peaking toward each other, a narrow band: a nasal, talking lead.

name: Late Vibrato Lead
description: Two saws and a vibrato that EG 1 fades in through the modulation VCA a moment into each note: a lead that sings as a player would.

name: Noise Breath Lead
description: VCO 1's triangle and pink noise into the high-pass's input, peaking softly: a breathy, flute-like lead.

name: Noisy Throat
description: Two saws at 16' and 8' through filters whose cutoffs take pink and white noise in EG 2's place: a breathy, rasping voice.

name: Octave Lead
description: The saw and VCO 2's saw an octave up, a short glide: a bright lead that doubles itself.

name: Pitch Bend Lead
description: EG 1 starts each note a little under the key and slides it up into tune, as a player bends a string: a bluesy lead.

name: Ring Lead
description: The ring modulator, VCO 2 a little under a fifth over VCO 1, through a low-pass with a peak: a clangorous, metallic lead.

name: Scream Glide
description: Both filters peaking hard toward each other, gliding between notes: the singing, screaming lead with a slide.

name: Screaming Lead
description: Both saws a few cents apart through the high-pass and the low-pass, each peaking hard, with a little vibrato: the lead the instrument is known for.

name: Soft Triangle Lead
description: VCO 1's triangle alone, a gentle glide and a slow vibrato: a soft, pure lead.

name: Square Lead
description: VCO 1's pulse at its square and VCO 2's square an octave up, the low-pass half open: a hollow, woody lead.

name: Thin Pulse Lead
description: VCO 1's pulse narrowed far, the high-pass taking away its body: a thin, reedy lead that cuts.

name: Trill Lead
description: The MG's square into the pitch through a patch, a whole step up and back several times a second: a trilling lead.

name: Wah Lead
description: Two saws through a peaking low-pass the envelope throws open and lets fall at each note: a lead that says wah.

name: Drone Pad
description: VCO 2 a fifth up, both saws at 16', the high-pass and the low-pass peaking slowly against each other on the MG: a dark, shifting drone.

name: Hollow Band
description: The saw and the narrow pulse through the two filters peaking toward each other, a band between them that the MG moves slowly: a hollow, vocal pad.

name: Noise Pad
description: The saw with pink noise into the high-pass's input, both through a peaking low-pass the MG moves slowly: a breathy, single-voice pad.

name: Slow Sweep
description: Two saws a few cents apart, the low-pass swept up over seconds by a slow EG 2 and down by its release: a single-voice swell for long notes.

name: Noise Hat
description: White noise with the high-pass taking all but its top, short: a closed hat.

name: Noise Snare
description: White noise and a little of the triangle high up, through the high-pass, struck and gone: a snare.

name: Synth Kick
description: VCO 1's triangle at 32', thrown up by EG 2 and falling to the key as it decays, short: a kick drum.

name: Synth Tom
description: The triangle with a little noise, falling a short way in pitch as EG 2 decays: a tuned tom.

name: Zap Perc
description: A square thrown up and falling fast through a peaking low-pass: an electronic zap for drum parts.

name: Band Pluck
description: The saw between the two filters, both peaking, struck and gone: a hollow, wooden pluck.

name: Muted Pluck
description: The square through a low-pass all but shut, flicked open for an instant: a muted, palm-damped pluck.

name: Pluck
description: VCO 1's pulse through a peaking low-pass on a short envelope with no sustain: each note a plucked string.

name: Resonant Pluck
description: The saw through a low-pass near singing, the envelope sweeping it down fast: a chirping pluck.

name: Ring Pluck
description: The ring modulator, VCO 2 an octave and a little over VCO 1, struck and ringing a moment: a metallic pluck.

name: Band Sequence
description: The saw between the filters peaking toward each other, short at each step: a vocal, talking sequence.

name: Glide Sequence
description: The square through a peaking low-pass with a fast glide, each step snapping the filter: a sliding acid sequence.

name: Pulsing Filter
description: The MG's falling saw snapping the peaking low-pass open and letting it fall, several times a second while a key is held: a filter that pulses on held notes.

name: Random Steps
description: Noise sampled by the MG's square into the low-pass: each step of a held note lands on a new random color.

name: Ring Sequence
description: The ring modulator at a short envelope: metallic blips for fast lines.

name: Tight Sequence
description: The saw at 16' through a peaking low-pass, a short envelope at each step: tight sixteenths.
